title: Mochizuki Honami — Fluffy Break Time〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Competition Venue
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome and Max are back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Congratulations.
You and Max put on a spectacular performance.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Yeah, especially with your last throw!
That was mind-blowingly awesome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was honestly a little startled since you never practiced doing such a long throw.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But what you did was super cool!
That was definitely the loudest the crowd's gotten so far!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hear that, Max...?

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For now, let's try to catch our breath before the next round starts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's a bench over there that you can use. Why don't you both...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong? Why are you shouting?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
But I just saw Samo... I mean, another Samoyed over there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that.
I think it's also in this competition...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I knew it!
Wow! I didn't know Samoyeds could do disc dog...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your dog did seem to have fun while we practiced, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, are you looking for a Shiba...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I was hoping to see one make a couple spectacular catches...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I'm not seeing any.
Does this mean Western dogs are more suited for this sport?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I think it's just that none happen to be in today's competition. I've seen some before at other ones.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm having such a hard time seeing Shibao do anything like this. On top of stubbornly liking to do things at his own pace, he gets bored so easily...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Haha. He did seem like the epitome of his breed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He really is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My bandmates and I played with him the other day, but he still ended up sitting down after getting bored.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They seemed to really enjoy how I got his face to scrunch up when he refused to move towards the end...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Scrunch up...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's what happens when Shibas refuse to go for a walk or return home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I've heard that their faces become all scrunched when they resist as you pull on their leash.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's a famous phenomenon among dog lovers! I think it's really cute how their breed's characteristics show like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cute? That makes them sound like a handful to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... Yes, he is a handful, and I get a little embarrassed whenever someone sees us in that situation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's natural for things to not go the way either of us want. After all, we're both living creatures.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Even dogs that are the same breed can have totally different personalities and preferences!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, just like us humans...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. I think Max is saying that he agrees.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No, wait... He might be trying to tell us that he's worked up an appetite after running around so much...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, bone appetit...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that's very clever of you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nothing. I was genuinely impressed by your response.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope your hard work is rewarded with a big feast, Max.

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof...!
